newsitem.title: USA: Public Storage reorganization plan approved.
newsitem.headline: Public Storage reorganization plan approved.

text.p: Public Storage Inc (PSA) and Public Storage Properties XII Inc (PSP12) said shareholders of PSP12 approved the plan of reorganization involving the merger between it and PSA.

They said the merger is expected to be completed on or about September 16, at which time two types of distributions will be payable to shareholders of PSP12. The first distribution of $0.94 per share in cash will be paid to all PSP12 shareholders and the second, of $21.49, will be paid in stock, for those shareholders electing a cash/stock combination.

PSA also said that the merger between it and Public Storage Properties X Inc (PSP10) was approved, and will also be competed around September 16. Payments under this merger will be $0.71 in cash to all shareholders plus $20.41 per share in stock for those electing the cash/stock combination.
The surviving entity of these mergers, PSA, is an equity real estate investment trust that invests mainly in storage properties.
